title: Inverse perpendicular cardinality
statement: For a subspace $A$ of the $n$-dimensional binary cube, define its inverse perpendicular cardinality to be $2^{-\operatorname{codim}(A)}$.
hypotheses_covered: A subspace $A$ of the $n$-dimensional binary cube
